title: Precipitation behavior during hot deformation of powder metallurgy Ti-Nb-Ta-Zr-Al high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by powder metallurgy using elemental powders (purity >99.5%) blended for 10h under argon, cold isostatic pressed at 200MPa, sintered at 1300°C for 16h in vacuum (1×10⁻³ Pa), then hot deformed at 800°C with strain rate 0.001s⁻¹
